2026-11-08T15:47:43.6829203Z     "body": "Fixes #1789\n\nFall back to Docker network mode \"default\" for Docker job steps in host-mode Forgejo runner.\n\nCurrently, in host mode and with no manual `container.network` configuration, docker:// job steps use the \"WORKFLOW-xxx\" job network, which is not created/initialized in host mode and thus starting the container fails (see #1789). Container and Dockerfile actions work because they use Docker's \"default\" network in [act/runner/action.go#L499-L502](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/src/tag/v13.2.1/act/runner/action.go#L499-L502). This PR uses the same logic as there: if `rc.JobContainer.ManagesOwnNetworking()` is set and there is no `container.network` configured, use the \"default\" network.\n\nClaude code helped me find the source of the problem; I wrote the fix and tests (mostly copy-pasted from the test case above in the same file) myself.\n\n## Checklist\n\n### Compliance\n\n- [X] I confirm that I make this contribution in accordance with [Forgejo's AI Agreement](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/governance/src/commit/9084720dc6a7fbf1d3f358919d46bd6adfb55287/AIAgreement.md).\n\n\u003c!--start release-notes-assistant--\u003e\n\u003c!--URL:https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner--\u003e\n- bug fixes\n  - [PR](https://code.forgejo.org/forgejo/runner/pulls/1790): \u003c!--number 1790 --\u003e\u003c!--line 0 --\u003e\u003c!--description Zml4OiBob3N0LW1vZGUgZG9ja2VyIGRlZmF1bHQgbmV0d29yaw==--\u003efix: host-mode docker default network\u003c!--description--\u003e\n\u003c!--end release-notes-assistant--\u003e\n",
